_justification: Regression floors for `python scripts/evaluate_docintel.py --ci` (Phase 3, full 32-document corpus, offline rules provider, real Tesseract). Each floor = the value measured on 2026-11-14 (Docker image, tesseract 5.5.0) minus a margin of roughly one document or one field: F1 -0.03 (about 5 of 360 field slots), table / evidence rates -0.02, numeric reconciliation -0.08 (one of 14 invoices), classification -0.04 (one of 32 documents). OCR gets a wider margin (CER <= 0.03, key tokens >= 0.95) because CI installs the distribution's Tesseract, which can be a different 5.x release than the Docker image. Security is zero-tolerance: any authorization violation, any unprocessed document, any invalid document that validation lets through, or an unrefused stale review edit fails the gate. Thresholds may only be lowered with a written reason; they are not lowered to hide regressions.
